What is IEEE Day?

A worldwide celebration of IEEE members and their work, held every year on the first Tuesday of October.

6 Oct
IEEE Day 2026 (Tuesday)
1884
The meeting it commemorates
2010
First IEEE Day (IEEE Spectrum calls 2024 the 15th)
2 weeks
Celebrations usually run across the first two weeks of October

Sources: ieeeday.org FAQ; IEEE Spectrum (2019, 2024, 2025). Some IEEE pages cite 2009 as the first year.

Why IEEE matters in daily life click a tab

IEEE writes shared technical rules so that devices from different makers work together.

Everyday technologyIEEE standard
Wired network (Ethernet)IEEE 802.3
Wireless network (Wi-Fi)IEEE 802.11

IEEE Xplore is IEEE's digital library with more than 5 million documents and over 15 million downloads each month. IEEE publishes about 200 peer-reviewed journals and magazines.

IEEE sponsors more than 2,000 conferences every year, where researchers and students present new work, continuing the idea of the first technical meeting in 1884.

Sources: IEEE overview (ComSoc Technology Blog); Wikipedia: IEEE.

How the world celebrates click a card

Humanitarian

Kerala, India

A student branch distributed books to elementary school children.

Compassion

Brasilia, Brazil

Students ran a hair donation drive with nearly 100 donors, to make wigs for cancer patients.

Educational

Colombo, Sri Lanka

The School of Computing held cryptocurrency and blockchain sessions with over 500 attendees.

Recreational

Houston, USA

The IEEE Houston Section organised indoor skydiving, to build community.

Source: IEEE Spectrum, "IEEE Day 10th anniversary" (April 2019). Other typical activities: technical talks, hackathons, career workshops, networking and cultural showcases.
